description: China Agricultural University supplies daily maize water-use observations from its Shiyanghe Experimental Station during 2009–2016. A large lysimeter measured evaporation and precipitation under border irrigation, and the repository describes instrument quality checks before release. The ScienceDB page lists an XLSX workbook with CC0 rights, making access and reuse free. These daily observations can calibrate crop-water balances and irrigation-demand simulations for the observed cultivation conditions. They are site-specific and should not be transferred to other soils, crop varieties or irrigation methods without checking those differences. The metadata does not establish the completeness of every growing season, and this review did not inspect workbook values. No directly related catalogue resource was identified.
name: A dataset of daily water consumption records for maize at Shiyanghe Experimental Station of China Agricultural University during 2009-2016
